subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配位化学：请判断下列配合物的几何构型：Cobalt tetracarbonyl hydride（HCo(CO)₄）？
A. Trigonal bipyramidal
B. Square pyramidal
C. Octahedral
D. Trigonal prismatic
explanation: Trigonal bipyramidal. Covalent count: Co (group 9) 9 e; 1 × H (X) 1 e; 4 × CO (L) 8 e: 18 e. Ionic count: the ligands carry a charge of −1 in all and the complex is neutral, so the metal is Co(I), d⁸; d⁸ + 10 e from the ligands = 18 e. The hydroformylation catalyst. H is an X ligand, so cobalt is Co(I).
